summary: Fixed race condition in add operation by implementing file-based locking using filelock library

changes.description: Added file-based locking to TodoApp class for add, mark_done, mark_undone, and remove operations

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Two concurrent add() operations should both succeed and result in both items being persisted
Concurrent add() from multiple processes should not cause data corruption or loss
Lock acquisition should timeout gracefully if lock cannot be obtained
acceptance_criteria.implementation: Raises TimeoutError with descriptive message after 30 seconds

risks_and_limitations: Lock files (.lock) will be created alongside the database file and not automatically cleaned up
If a process crashes while holding the lock, other processes may need to wait for timeout or manually remove the lock file
